title: Tariff invariant regression coverage
task: Create two exhaustive regression tests using app.pricing.quote. First verify monotonicity: quote(g) <= quote(g + 1) for every integer g from 1 through 29999. Then verify the exact kilogram increment: quote(g + 1000) - quote(g) == 300 for every integer g from 1 through 29000. Preserve all existing implementation and tests. Use only the standard library and the installed pytest; do not add dependencies or fetch anything.
